author: /root/he_ephase_implementation

contentReview.twoIndependentCases: Each case independently constructs two rays, derives the lens equation solution, runs and interprets five numerical model cases, and justifies a model limit.
contentReview.coverage: The single covered atom requires ray construction, lens equation, simulation, quantitative sharpness and model limits. All components are required in both cases.
contentReview.prerequisites: Only the actual lens-eye competence is required. No source membership, assessment coverage or new prerequisite is invented to satisfy QA.
contentReview.bilingual: Both task and solution versions inspected in full, including corrected object heights, image heights, central-ray slopes and near-focus values.
contentReview.correction: Author replaced overly large object heights A9/B5 mm with A1.8/B1.0 mm after independent paraxial-consistency objection. Corrected image heights are both -0.2 mm.
contentReview.scope: Own school model task, explicitly not an official examination, biological measurement, medical assertion or evidence of actual learner success.
contentReview.rubric: Missing any core gives zero in that core; threshold23/24 cannot compensate for a missing core. Exhaustive arithmetic check is separate from this content judgment.

limitations: No human learner trial has been performed.
Review covers the pinned needs_review candidate; release metadata and catalog insertion must be verified separately.
